concepts.statement: Shared vocabulary for read-only dynasty strategy explanations.
Language for describing short-, medium-, and long-window dynasty assets.
Definitions for roster-level competitive state without changing Team Direction.
Rules for discussing whether roster assets align with a team timeline.
Vocabulary for trade-market liquidity signals when supplied by a future contract.
Vocabulary for role-security signals when supplied by a future contract.
Vocabulary for age and experience bands when supplied by a future contract.
Consumer boundary that ontology language cannot replace upstream evidence.
Slotted explanation structure for future deterministic template selection.
Decision-support boundary preserving manager ownership of final choices.
Unavailable or missing inputs must block assignment rather than invent continuity.

roster_state_definitions.definition: Roster-state vocabulary for a roster with credible present-window evidence.
Roster-state vocabulary for a roster needing longer-window accumulation.
Roster-state vocabulary for partial competitive reset framing.
Roster-state vocabulary when evidence is insufficient or unavailable.
Roster-state vocabulary for young assets aligned to a later window.
Roster-state vocabulary for veteran-heavy near-term windows.
Roster-state vocabulary for limited market flexibility when supplied.
Roster-state vocabulary for mixed asset timelines.

timeline_rules.statement: Do not infer age_band if not supplied by a governed input.
Do not infer experience_band if not supplied by a governed input.
Do not infer role_security_signal if not supplied by a governed input.
Do not infer market_liquidity_signal if not supplied by a governed input.
Short-window language requires explicit future contract inputs.
Long-window language requires explicit future contract inputs.
Team Direction remains the existing Management classifier output.
Generated baselines cannot satisfy evidence requirements.
Missing required inputs block assignment and template selection.

required_inputs.description: Age band supplied by a future governed producer.
Experience band supplied by a future governed producer.
Role security signal supplied by a future governed producer.
Market liquidity signal supplied by a future governed producer.

consumer_safety_rules.statement: The ontology cannot override canonical identity or crosswalk outputs.
The ontology cannot override team, roster, or league assignment.
The ontology cannot override FORGE evidence or scoring provenance.
Generated/default baselines remain visibility only and cannot count as evidence.
The ontology cannot create projections, rankings, or player-level forecasts.
The ontology cannot assign player archetypes without governed future inputs and an explicit consumer phase.
The ontology cannot consume operator notes as evidence.
The ontology cannot replace the human manager's final decision.
